instruction: How can governments utilize fiscal and monetary policies to combat economic recessions?
medusa_output:
Governments can utilize fiscal and monetary policies to combat economic recessions. Fiscal policies refer to government spending and taxation policies, while monetary policies refer to the actions taken by central banks.

During an economic recession, governments can use fiscal policies
